notes: v1.0.14 — Shaders now launch and play normally (the Shader Guard is a safety net, not a gate: borderline hardware gets a warning but always proceeds; only a real failure triggers recovery). Frame-rate safety: the engine ALWAYS caps FPS by default (matches your monitor refresh, max 240) so the GPU never runs unbounded — fixes whole-PC thermal/power crashes; 'Unlimited FPS' is a warned opt-in in Settings. The FPS Boost mod (v1.0.2) gained a watchdog that re-asserts the cap every 5s, plus a SafetyGate that auto-disables any render module that keeps failing instead of crashing on a 'render frame' error. The Crash Assistant now recognizes render-frame failures and logs the full crash report.
